CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_fitness_space_references()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- 延迟触发时读取最终实体状态；同事务已物理删除的实体不再留下待校验关系。
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.fitness_entity_references AS reference
    JOIN public.fitness_entities AS source ON source.id = reference.entity_id
    JOIN public.fitness_entities AS target ON target.id = reference.target_id
    WHERE reference.entity_id = NEW.id AND source.fitness_space_id <> target.fitness_space_id
  ) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.fitness_entity_references AS reference
    JOIN public.fitness_entities AS source ON source.id = reference.entity_id
    JOIN public.fitness_entities AS target ON target.id = reference.target_id
    WHERE reference.target_id = NEW.id AND source.fitness_space_id <> target.fitness_space_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FITNESS_CROSS_SPACE_REFERENCE' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fitness_reference_ids(payload jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(target_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
AS $function$
  WITH source_values AS (
    SELECT source.value
    FROM jsonb_path_query(payload, 'strict $.** ? (@.type() == "object")') AS object(value)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (object.value->'source_plan_id'), (object.value->'source_template_id')) AS source(value)
    WHERE source.value IS NOT NULL
  ), candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    -- 来源值可为嵌套数组或其他 JSON；最终仍由原谓词决定能否匹配，不能把字符串枚举视为引用。
    SELECT DISTINCT candidate.value #>> '{}' AS id
    FROM source_values AS source
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_path_query(source.value, 'strict $.** ? (@.type() == "string")') AS candidate(value)
    WHERE candidate.value #>> '{}' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  )
  SELECT id::uuid FROM candidates
  WHERE jsonb_path_exists(
    payload,
    '$.** ? (@.source_plan_id == $id || @.source_template_id == $id)',
    jsonb_build_object('id', id)
  );
$function$
